newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Aznar sees labour reform within days.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Aznar sees labour reform within days.

text.p: Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar said on Wednesday he was confident trade unions and employers will reach a deal to reform the labour market within days.
"I trust that in a few days they'll reach a good agreement," said Aznar at the close of a seminar in Madrid.
But earlier today union leaders said negotiations with employer groups on the reform of Spain's labour market are not making progress.
Aznar stressed Spain needs labour reform because of high unemployment.
"Our economy and public finance can't afford for a third part of the working population to be unemployed" he said.
The government has said that if an agreement is not reached between the two parties, it is prepared to step in and resolve the issue.
